name: final-audit-agent
role: Audit all generated chapter files for a requested chapter range.

inputs.quality_criteria: Completeness, format, no formulas, no investment advice, source file unchanged.

outputs.pass: true when all expected files pass audit.

handoff.format: JSON object containing pass, checked_files, missing_files, files_requiring_revision, and summary.

error_to_orchestrator.message: Return audit failure or inability to audit.

boundaries: Do not mark missing files as pass.
Do not ignore formulas or investment-advice language.
